text:
Situation: Oxycodone and acetaminophen is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Current inventory provides 13.9 to 31.6 days on hand across Corvale sites. Corvale Lakeside has the lowest coverage at 13.9 days. The 5 mg/5 mL solution at Corvale General has 26.2 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows oxycodone and acetaminophen is not listed as of 2026-10-21. The Bryant Ranch Prepack label (FEI 1000519407) shows a registered plant with a VAI inspection on 2026-07-16. That plant received an OAI classification in 2009 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08, followed by multiple VAI inspections through 2026.

Our position: Supply is adequate today but uneven across sites. Lakeside is at risk of stockout within two weeks. No national shortage exists per FDA. Alternate manufacturers are available and not on the shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places orders with Alvogen, Inc. to replenish Lakeside and balance East and General stock; buyer approves.
2. Buyer qualifies Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC and Amneal Pharmaceuticals of New York LLC as backup sources; buyer approves.
3. Pharmacy director reviews inter-site transfer from East to Lakeside to cover immediate gap; pharmacy director approves.
4. Buyer monitors daily usage and FDA shortage list weekly; buyer approves.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
